name: Full net-worth picture
goal: Assemble a complete, current net-worth picture: pull balances and holdings from every linked financial account, scan email for outstanding debt, and write a one-page summary.

steps.instruction: Build a net-worth summary: total assets (cash + investments + crypto) minus total liabilities (loans, cards, mortgages), the month-over-month delta if prior data exists, the largest assets and debts, and one concrete action to improve net worth. Use only the gathered data; flag anything that looks stale or missing.
steps.label: Synthesize net-worth summary
